items.title: Witch with a Guiding Lantern
items.alt: A friendly witch checks a map while holding a small brass lantern.
items.description: A friendly witch in a plum coat holds a small brass lantern forward while checking a folded blank map in her other hand. One boot steps ahead, no broom. Use this illustration for personal storytelling, classroom activity cards and seasonal crafts.

items.title: Witch Tasting a Potion
items.alt: A witch in an apron tastes a steaming potion from a small cauldron.
items.description: A round-cheeked witch in an apron carefully lifts a wooden tasting spoon from a small three-legged cauldron; a single curl of steam rises, her free hand rests on the rim handle. Use this illustration for personal storytelling, classroom activity cards and seasonal crafts.
